==Description==
{{Description|This enemy has {{Color|help|higher RES|nobold=1}} to {{Color|Aero|Aero DMG|nobold=1}}.
Gibbon-like lifeforms primarily gathered in deep woodlands, Hoochiefs have the tendency to show off their supremacy by stealing human belongings.
Unlike other Hoochiefs, Hoochief Cyclones can conjure air currents to not only launch long-range attacks but also restrict the movement of its targets.|Description When Discovered}}
